title: Eval tally takes the expected answer from a name
what: evals/judge-measure/tally.py decides whether a question should be judged PASS or FAIL from the name of its grader (yes--NN-... or no--NN-..., tally.py:6 and :62); store the expected answer as a field next to the grader.
why: A typo in a grader name (yes-- for no--) makes the tally judge a right judge as wrong, and nothing in the result says why.
failing_case: give a grader that should be judged FAIL a name starting yes-- in an eval's result: tally.py expects PASS, counts the judge's right FAIL votes as wrong and exits 1; the expected answer should be a stored field that a name cannot change
pass_cases: a run whose grader names carry the right yes--/no-- prefixes tallies correctly today
